newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on moderate short-covering on Tuesday, with bullish sentiment carried over from Monday when the stronger expiry price of spot May lifted prices, traders said.
The newly listed benchmark November contract ended at 138.3 yen per kg after opening at 139.6. Other prices ranged from 1.3 to 2.0 yen per kg higher.

"The market lacked fresh incentives. The topside was capped by selling as private investors were waiting for price rises to sell," one trader said. "Rubber prices are likely to drift within tight ranges for some time."
